text:
Alex: seeing steady inference tail latency spikes from the us-west GPU pool starting ~03:20 UTC. P50 fine but P95/P99 doubled. Anyone seeing hardware alerts?
Maya: yep, noticed `nvidia-smi` reporting fan speed as N/A on one card and power limit dropping intermittently.
Alex: logs show a few Xid errors: `Xid(13) 79` and increasing ECC correctable counts on GPU0.
Taylor: which node?
Alex: gw-usw2-gpu-03 in us-west2-pool-rack-4.
Maya: cluster health: `thermal_throttle: true`, `power_limit_restricted: true` for that node in the node-exporter payload. Screenshot in the thread.
Priya: I'll cordon and drain it now: `kubectl drain node/gw-usw2-gpu-03 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` ETA ~10m.
infra-bot: Autoscaler: spinning up 2 replacement workers from dedicated pool to absorb pod move :gear:.
Alex: nvml query sequence I ran: `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=index,fan.speed,power.limit,pstate --format=csv` returned alternating rows like `0, N/A, 175 W, P0` and then `0, N/A, 120 W, P2` which lines up with latency spikes.
Taylor: could be fan tach sensor failing or fan controller dropping off the i2c bus. Can you run `sudo nvmlDeviceGetThermalSettings` or check `i2cdetect -y` on the host?
Maya: also saw intermittent `fan_speed: 0` in metrics before it flipped to `N/A`.
Priya: drain completed, pods rescheduled to gw-usw2-gpu-07 and -09. Observed latency returning near baseline after reschedule.
Alex: cordoned and powering off node for hardware swap: `ipmitool -I lanplus -H <bmc> -U admin chassis power off` scheduled 03:55 UTC.
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0318-01, severity: medium, runbook: gpu-fan-throttle.
Maya: opened hardware ticket TKT-7832 with onsite team and tagged @ops to check PSU rails and fan controller.
Taylor: hypothesis: fan tach sensor intermittency triggers driver to apply conservative power cap -> thermal throttle -> Xid errors under sustained load. PSU ripple could also cause power-limit fallback.
Alex: similar symptom seen Q4 last year but that one was BIOS power-governor misconfig on 3 cards in rack-2. worth checking BIOS and BMC firmware too.
Priya: will swap GPU in slot 2 once powered down; if swap clears errors we'll RMA the card. Spare inventory note: low on our preferred model, raising procurement alert.
Maya: follow-ups: add alert for `fan_speed == N/A` (per-card) and for sudden power_limit drop >30W; create Grafana panel showing per-card fan/tach/power transitions alongside Xid/ECC rate.
Taylor: +1 add Xid rate alert when >1/min over a 5m window.
Alex: also schedule automated nvml poll that logs raw NVML fan and power samples every 10s for 1h after anomalies for postmortem.
infra-bot: Maintenance scheduled: 2026-03-18 04:30-05:00 UTC for node swap (gw-usw2-gpu-03).
Priya: swap done, verifying post-swap health. Initial checks look good; Xid/ECC counters stopped rising.
Alex: thanks everyone. Keeping node offline until RMA confirmed. Will close the incident after spare replacement and firmware checks. :thumbsup:
Maya: adding docs link to runbook: /docs/runbooks/gpu-hardware-triage for next steps.
Taylor: good catch, team.
ops-bot: Reminder: update INC-2026-0318-01 with RCA when available.
